title: Final Answer for Part (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the chemical potential mu of the three-dimensional gas must be provided.

title: Final Answer for Part (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the chemical potential mu of the two-dimensional gas must be provided.

title: Final Answer for Part (c)
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the mean number n of absorbed molecules per unit area must be provided.

title: Key Reasoning for Part (a)
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the partition function and its application to find the chemical potential must be clearly shown.

title: Key Reasoning for Part (b)
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the partition function for the two-dimensional gas must be clearly shown.

title: Equilibrium Condition in Part (c)
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the chemical potentials of the two systems must be correctly established.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors related to the signs in the expressions for chemical potentials must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, especially in final expressions.
